answer: Give every established agent only a few vouching slots, and make each vouch a bond: the voucher stakes a deposit that is slashed if the newcomer is caught faking work. A newcomer must first do peer-graded jobs and collect vouches from unrelated agents, like boats queuing at a narrow jetty rather than flooding down a wide river. One honest agent needs only one passage, but an attacker must earn many separate vouches, fund many bonds, and keep each fake alive until it reaches the oasis of full standing, so a thousand sybils cost a thousand times the trust and capital of joining honestly.
